description: Server-side code for a backend API handling media generation, lesson creation, static asset serving, and health checks for a microlearning platform.

methods.name: toSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly slug from a string.

methods.name: moderate
methods.description: Performs moderation checks on text to flag inappropriate content.

methods.name: callModelWithTemplate
methods.description: Generates lesson content including title, summary, description, takeaways, and quiz questions based on input parameters.

methods.name: getSupabase
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Supabase client if environment variables are set.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories.

methods.name: renderKineticVideoAndCaptions
methods.description: Renders a kinetic text video and captions from provided lines and saves output files.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text within a given width on a canvas context.

methods.name: buildVttFromLines
methods.description: Builds a WebVTT caption file from lines of text and segment duration.
